summary: Docspell is a self-hosted document management system designed to organise and archive digital files. It features automated tagging to help sort incoming paperwork without manual intervention. The application is packaged for containerised environments.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams looking to centralise their paperwork and automate basic filing tasks using a dedicated local archive.
watchOut: The JVM-based runtime can demand higher memory overhead compared to lightweight alternatives, and you should consider whether the moderate maintenance activity fits your long-term stability requirements.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your file storage and database data, along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
